title: Fanin bound after fanout reduction
statement: Let $C$ be a finite directed acyclic Boolean circuit in which every gate has distinct arguments, every NOT gate has exactly one argument, and every gate has at most two arguments. The circuit obtained by the fanout reduction construction also has distinct arguments at every gate, has exactly one argument at each NOT gate, and has at most two arguments at every gate.
hypotheses_covered: C is a DAG circuit with n input vertices
C is well formed: every gate has distinct arguments and each NOT gate has exactly one argument
Every gate has at most two arguments
